expectation_resolution.expected_evidence: Synthetic fixture evidence in the case category section; empty when unanswerable.

fixture_boundary: Synthetic cases validate evaluator behavior only; real FLEXCUBE documents, live providers, and human review are required before quality claims.

review_protocol.reviewer_qualification: FLEXCUBE L1 support or domain expertise
review_protocol.evidence_rule: A claim is supported only when an indexed source entails it.
review_protocol.partial_answer_rule: Unsupported portions must be labelled explicitly.
review_protocol.citation_rule: Every displayed citation must be locatable and materially support its claim.
review_protocol.sc_pass_rule: SC-003 = passed answerable cases / all answerable cases; pass at >= 0.90.
